summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which was unreachable, so payments failed silently (DEBUG only) and orders were marked processed without payment. Worker got stuck in a wait state, so the queue backed up (a restart fixed it; the deeper cause is unknown).
recommended: Validate that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the provider migration.
Alert on payment provider failures logged at DEBUG.
Investigate why the worker stalled in the wait state.
